name: msp_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for MSP procurement authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: msp_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT register farmer or check MSP rates. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: msp_register_farmer
description: Registers farmer for MSP procurement. Only registered farmers can participate. Transitions registration_status to 'registered'. Requires session_token. Does NOT declare crops. Fails if already registered or invalid details.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_check_msp_rates
description: Returns government-fixed MSP rates for supported crops. Rates are fixed and non-negotiable. PUBLIC — can be called without session. Does NOT register or procure. Fails if crop is unsupported.

name: msp_declare_crop
description: Declares crop and expected quantity for the procurement season. Required before procurement. Transitions procurement_status to 'declared'. Requires session_token. Does NOT schedule mandi visit. Fails if farmer not registered, crop unsupported, or duplicate declaration exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_generate_procurement_token
description: Generates a procurement token for mandi visit. Token is required before visiting. Crop must be declared first. Transitions procurement_status to 'scheduled'. Requires session_token. Does NOT schedule time — use msp_schedule_mandi_visit. Fails if crop not declared or duplicate token exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

mandi_id.description: Unique identifier of the procurement mandi.

name: msp_get_mandi_list
description: Returns list of active procurement mandis in a state/district. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate tokens. Fails if no mandis active in the region.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_schedule_mandi_visit
description: Schedules a specific date/time for mandi visit. Token must be generated. Requires session_token. Does NOT deliver produce. Fails if no token exists or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_record_produce_delivery
description: Records delivery of produce at the mandi. Transitions procurement_status to 'delivered'. Requires session_token. Does NOT perform quality check. Fails if not scheduled, wrong mandi, or exceeding declared quantity.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_check_quality_status
description: Checks quality inspection results. Returns quality_grade ('FAQ' or 'below_FAQ'). Produce must meet Fair Average Quality standards. Substandard produce is rejected. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify results. Fails if produce not delivered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_check_procurement_status
description: Returns current procurement_status ('not_declared' through 'payment_processed') with details. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify status. Fails if token is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_track_payment
description: Tracks payment status ('pending', 'initiated', 'completed', 'failed'). Payment processed only after acceptance. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate payments. Fails if procurement not accepted.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_cancel_token
description: Cancels a procurement token. Only possible before delivery. Requires session_token. Does NOT refund or modify declarations. Fails if produce already delivered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_raise_grievance
description: Raises MSP grievance. Categories: 'payment_delay', 'procurement_rejection', 'quantity_mismatch', 'mandi_issue', 'registration_issue'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if invalid category.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: msp_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks MSP grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
